content.title: Pork Prices Continue to Rise From Lower Hog Production, Smithfield Says
content.summary: Prices for bacon, ham and other deli meats are rising after disease outbreaks earlier in the year crimped hog production in the Midwest, executives at Smithfield Foods said.  Smithfield, the largest pork processor in the U.S., says an outbreak of the PRRS virus has resulted in shortages of certain cuts like pork bellies used to make consumer favorites such as bacon.  Prices for Smithfield’s packaged meat products, such as sausages and hot dogs, were up 9% for the three-month period that ended Sept. 28.

content.title: Jennifer Garner's Once Upon a Farm discloses revenue jump amid busy U.S. IPO market
content.summary: Once Upon a Farm, the organic baby food company co-founded by actor Jennifer Garner, revealed higher six-month revenue in a U.S. IPO filing on Monday, becoming the latest company to seek a listing amid strong investor demand. U.S. IPO activity has picked up in recent months, reversing a slowdown earlier in the year when trade-policy uncertainty curbed momentum. Black Rock Coffee Bar, cybersecurity firm Netskope and WaterBridge Infrastructure all saw strong debuts earlier this month, while the largest U.S. pork processor Smithfield Foods raised $571.7 million in an IPO in January.
